import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')

    for c in range(3,8):
        ws.cell(r,c).value = '=SUMPRODUCT((\$B\$17:\$B\$24=\$B%d)*(\$C\$17:\$G\$24))' % r
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
